items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I went there and Alvin Snyder didn't show up.

ctx.x: Well, that day -- I used to divide my time with my grandmother who lived on the east side and my mother who lived on the west side. So this day I told my grandmother that I would stay with my mother that night and I got up and put on my suit, which was a common thing, put my overalls over my suit, and I went onto the west side. And after supper I told my mother I was going over to stay with my grandmother.

So we were supposed to meet at the pool. The train left about 11:00 o'clock so we were going to meet at 10:30 at the poolhall on the corner of 12th and Center. And I went there and Alvin Snyder didn't show up. So now I'm stuck, I don't know what to do. Bill's got my horn. So I ran into another friend of mine who did this thing all the time, his name was Clifford Finney. I said, 'Clifford, I -- you know, I told him the story. He said, 'don't worry, I'll go with you.'
So we go down and this train pulled out. We jumped
